description: A snowy night scene in an oil-painting style. A domed white building with columns stands on the left under a dark sky, with snow falling. In the foreground, several dark-clothed workers shovel snow across a drifted plaza, and steps lead up toward a railing. On the right, a tall arched window glows with warm light, showing a crowded chamber of men in dark suits and robes; a large man in a dark coat raises his right hand near the window.
